import requests
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import date

API_URL = ''https://dashboard-cs-production.up.railway.app''
API_KEY = ''chiave-segreta-admin-2024''

reports = [
    \(''ANTONIA/reports/Report_crediti_kim.html'', ''crediti_kim'', ''Report Crediti KIM - 04/02/2026''\),
    \(''ANTONIA/reports/Report_crediti_Massimo.html'', ''crediti_massimo'', ''Report Crediti MASSIMO - 04/02/2026''\),
    \(''ANTONIA/reports/Report_vendite_progressivo_Kim.html'', ''vendite_kim'', ''Report Vendite Progressivo KIM - 04/02/2026''\),
    \(''ANTONIA/reports/Report_vendite_progressivo_Detto.html'', ''vendite_massimo'', ''Report Vendite Progressivo MASSIMO - 04/02/2026''\),
]

data_oggi = date.today\(\).strftime\(''%Y-%m-%d''\)

for file_path, tipo, titolo in reports:
    try:
        contenuto = Path\(file_path\).read_text\(encoding=''utf-8''\)
        payload = {
            ''tipo'': tipo,
            ''titolo'': titolo,
            ''data_report'': data_oggi,
            ''contenuto_html'': contenuto
        }
        resp = requests.post\(
            f''{API_URL}/api/reports'',
            json=payload,
            headers={''Content-Type'': ''application/json'', ''X-API-Key'': API_KEY},
            timeout=30
        \)
        if resp.status_code == 201:
            print\(f''[OK] {tipo}: caricato \(ID: {resp.json\(\).get\(""id""\)}\)''\)
        else:
            print\(f''[ERR] {tipo}: {resp.status_code} - {resp.text[:100]}''\)
    except Exception as e:
        print\(f''[ERR] {tipo}: {e}''\)
")
